lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨੀਸਾਣਿ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad neesaan thaak na paaeeai ||
lines.translation: No one blocks the way of those who are blessed with the Banner of the True Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੁਝਿ ਵਖਾਣਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਈਐ ॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: sach sun bujh vakhaan mahal bulaaeeai ||18||
lines.translation: Hearing, understanding and speaking Truth, one is called to the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||18||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਰਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਹਿਵੈ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਧਾ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: pahiraa agan hivai ghar baadhaa bhojan saar karaaee ||
lines.translation: If I dressed myself in fire, and built my house of snow, and made iron my food;

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਪਾਣੀ ਕਰਿ ਪੀਵਾ ਧਰਤੀ ਹਾਕ ਚਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagale dookh paanee kar peevaa dharatee haak chalaaee ||
lines.translation: and if I were to drink in all pain like water, and drive the entire earth before me;

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਿ ਤਾਰਾਜੀ ਅੰਬਰੁ ਤੋਲੀ ਪਿਛੈ ਟੰਕੁ ਚੜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhar taaraajee a(n)bar tolee pichhai ta(n)k chaRaaee ||
lines.translation: and if I were to place the earth upon a scale and balance it with a single copper coin;

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਵਡੁ ਵਧਾ ਮਾਵਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਭਸੈ ਨਥਿ ਚਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: evad vadhaa maavaa naahee sabhasai nath chalaaee ||
lines.translation: and if I were to become so great that I could not be contained, and if I were to control and lead all;

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਤਾ ਤਾਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਰੀ ਭਿ ਆਖਿ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: etaa taan hovai man a(n)dar karee bh aakh karaaee ||
lines.translation: and if I were to possess so much power within my mind that I could cause others to do my bidding-so what?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਵਡੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਤੇਵਡ ਦਾਤੀ ਦੇ ਦੇ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jevad saahib tevad daatee de de kare rajaaee ||
lines.translation: As Great as our Lord and Master is, so great are His gifts. He bestows them according to His Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਉਪਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak nadar kare jis upar sach naam vadiaaee ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, obtain the glorious greatness of the True Name. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਖਣੁ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਰਜਿਆ ਸੁਨਣਿ ਨ ਰਜੇ ਕੰਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: aakhan aakh na rajiaa sunan na raje ka(n)n ||
lines.translation: The mouth is not satisfied by speaking, and the ears are not satisfied by hearing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਰਜੀਆ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਕ ਇਕ ਵੰਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: akhee dekh na rajeeaa gun gaahak ik va(n)n ||
lines.translation: The eyes are not satisfied by seeing-each organ seeks out one sensory quality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੁਖਿਆ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਗਲੀ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhukhiaa bhukh na utarai galee bhukh na jaai ||
lines.translation: The hunger of the hungry is not appeased; by mere words, hunger is not relieved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੁਖਾ ਤਾ ਰਜੈ ਜਾ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhukhaa taa rajai jaa gun kahi gunee samaai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, hunger is relieved only when one utters the Glorious Praises of the Praiseworthy Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin sache sabh kooR kooR kamaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Without the True One, all are false, and all practice falsehood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੁ ਬੰਨਿ ਚਲਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin sache kooRiaar ba(n)n chalaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Without the True One, the false ones are bound and gagged and driven off.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਤਨੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਛਾਰੁ ਰਲਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin sache tan chhaar chhaar ralaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Without the True One, the body is just ashes, and it mingles again with ashes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਜਿ ਪੈਝੈ ਖਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin sache sabh bhukh j paijhai khaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Without the True Ome, all food and clothes are unsatisfying.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਸਚੇ ਦਰਬਾਰੁ ਕੂੜਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: vin sache darabaar kooR na paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Without the True One, the false ones do not attain the Lord's Court.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੈ ਲਾਲਚਿ ਲਗਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਖੁਆਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooRai laalach lag mahal khuaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Attached to false attachments, the Mansion of the Lord's Presence is lost.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਠਗਿਓ ਠਗਿ ਆਈਐ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh jag thagio thag aaeeai jaaeeai ||
lines.translation: The whole world is deceived by deception, coming and going in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈਐ ॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: tan mahi trisanaa ag sabad bujhaaeeai ||19||
lines.translation: Within the body is the fire of desire; through the Word of the Shabad, it is quenched. ||19||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਰੁਖੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਫੁਲੁ ਫਲ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak gur sa(n)tokh rukh dharam phul phal giaan ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Guru is the tree of contentment, with flowers of faith, and fruits of spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿਆ ਹਰਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਪਕੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਧਿਆਨਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ras rasiaa hariaa sadaa pakai karam dhiaan ||
lines.translation: Watered with the Lord's Love, it remains forever green; through the karma of good deeds and meditation, it ripens.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਕੇ ਸਾਦ ਖਾਦਾ ਲਹੈ ਦਾਨਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: pat ke saad khaadaa lahai daanaa kai sir daan ||1||
lines.translation: Honor is obtained by eating this tasty dish; of all gifts, this is the greatest gift. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਇਨੇ ਕਾ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਪਤ ਪਰਵਾਲਾ ਫੁਲ ਜਵੇਹਰ ਲਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: suine kaa birakh pat paravaalaa phul javehar laal ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the tree of gold, with leaves of coral, and blossoms of jewels and rubies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਫਲ ਰਤਨ ਲਗਹਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਖਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tit phal ratan lagahi mukh bhaakhit hiradai ridai nihaal ||
lines.translation: The Words from His Mouth are fruits of jewels. Within His Heart, He beholds the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak karam hovai mukh masatak likhiaa hovai lekh ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, He is obtained by those, upon whose faces and foreheads such pre-recorded destiny is written.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਠਿਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਪੂਜੈ ਸਦਾ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: athisath teerath gur kee charanee poojai sadaa visekh ||
lines.translation: The sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage are contained in the constant worship of the feet of the Exalted Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੰਸੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਕੋਪੁ ਚਾਰੇ ਨਦੀਆ ਅਗਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ha(n)s het lobh kop chaare nadeeaa ag ||
lines.translation: Cruelty, material attachment, greed and anger are the four rivers of fire.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਵਹਿ ਦਝਹਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਤਰੀਐ ਕਰਮੀ ਲਗਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: pavahi dajhahi naanakaa tareeai karamee lag ||2||
lines.translation: Falling into them, one is burned, O Nanak! One is saved only by holding tight to good deeds. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮਰੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevadiaa mar maar na pachhotaaeeai ||
lines.translation: While you are alive, conquer death, and you shall have no regrets in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਝੂਠਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jhoothaa ihu sa(n)saar kin samajhaaeeai ||
lines.translation: This world is false, but only a few understand this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਨ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਧਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach na dhare piaar dha(n)dhai dhaaeeai ||
lines.translation: People do not enshrine love for the Truth; they chase after worldly affairs instead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਖੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਦੁਨੀਆਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaal buraa khai kaal sir duneeaaeeai ||
lines.translation: The terrible time of death and annihilation hovers over the heads of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਦਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukamee sir ja(n)daar maare daaeeai ||
lines.translation: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the Messenger of Death smashes his club over their heads.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape dei piaar ma(n)n vasaaeeai ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself gives His Love, and enshrines it within their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨ ਚਸਾ ਵਿਲੰਮੁ ਭਰੀਐ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: muhat na chasaa vila(n)m bhareeai paaeeai ||
lines.translation: Not a moment or an instant's delay is permitted, when one's measure of life is full.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੨੦॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee bujh sach samaaeeai ||20||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, one comes to know the True One, and is absorbed into Him. ||20||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮੀ ਤੁਮਾ ਵਿਸੁ ਅਕੁ ਧਤੂਰਾ ਨਿਮੁ ਫਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumee tumaa vis ak dhatooraa nim phal ||
lines.translation: Bitter melon, swallow-wort, thorn-apple and nim fruit

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂੰ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mukh vasahi tis jis too(n) chit na aavahee ||
lines.translation: these bitter poisons lodge in the minds and mouths of those who do not remember You

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹੀਐ ਕਿਸੁ ਹੰਢਨਿ ਕਰਮਾ ਬਾਹਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kaheeai kis ha(n)dhan karamaa baahare ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, how shall I tell them this? Without the karma of good deeds, they are only destroying themselves. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਤਿ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਕਬ ਉਤਮ ਕਬ ਨੀਚ ॥
lines.transliteration: mat pa(n)kheroo kirat saath kab utam kab neech ||
lines.translation: The intellect is a bird; on account of its actions, it is sometimes high, and sometimes low.
